sql: SELECT model, is_test, count(*) AS calls, count(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS convs, sum(input_tokens) AS inp, sum(cached_input_tokens) AS cached, sum(output_tokens) AS outp, round(sum(cost_usd)::numeric, 4) AS registrado, round((sum(input_tokens) * 2.5 + sum(cached_input_tokens) * 0.25 + sum(output_tokens) * 15) / 1e6, 4) AS se_gpt54, round((sum(input_tokens) * 0.75 + sum(cached_input_tokens) * 0.075 + sum(output_tokens) * 4.5) / 1e6, 4) AS se_mini FROM ai_agent_usage WHERE kind = 'chat' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
